exposure: American Society of Anesthesiologist (ASA) physical status III
American Society of Anesthesiologist (ASA) physical status IV
cohort: 2530 adult participants (18 years and above) who underwent surgery at Tibebe Ghion Specialised Hospital were enrolled.
finding: The incidence rate of perioperative mortality was 1.37 deaths per 1000 person-day observations, with regional anaesthesia significantly associated with lower postoperative mortality, and age >=65 years, ASA physical status III and IV, emergency surgery, and preoperative oxygen saturation <95% significantly associated with a higher risk.
